articles.title: What Is Lujo Virus And Why Is It So Deadly?
articles.what_happened: The Lujo virus, a member of the Arenavirus family, has been identified as a potentially deadly pathogen. It has caused a handful of infections, with the original outbreak being highly fatal.
articles.key_details: The Lujo virus is related to other human pathogens like the Lassa virus, and its outbreaks have been limited so far. The virus is from the same family as other significant human diseases, and its effects can be devastating.
articles.why_it_matters: The Lujo virus is significant because it can cause highly fatal outbreaks, and its relatively recent discovery highlights the ongoing battle between humans and emerging viral pathogens.

articles.title: 129-Year-Old Long-Lost Film Starring First Ever On-Screen "Robot" Rediscovered In Old Wooden Trunk
articles.what_happened: A rare 129-year-old film, Gugusse and the Automaton, has been rediscovered in an old wooden trunk in Michigan. The film is a 45-second short by Georges Méliès, a French filmmaker.
articles.key_details: The film depicts a magician's comical altercation with a mechanical clown, the first on-screen portrayal of a robot. It was found among 10 other films in the trunk, which belonged to Bill McFarland's great-grandfather. The film is a nitrate film, a type of early film stock.
articles.why_it_matters: The discovery of this film is significant as it showcases the early beginnings of robotics in cinema. It provides a unique glimpse into the history of film and technology.

articles.title: 56-Million-Year-Old Fossil May Be The World’s Oldest Cannabis Plant By About 30 Million Years
articles.what_happened: A 56-million-year-old fossil has been discovered, potentially being the world's oldest known cannabis plant. This fossil has been dated to the Lower Eocene period.
articles.key_details: The fossil was found in a museum collection and had been gathering dust since its discovery almost 150 years ago. The oldest known cannabis pollen samples previously dated to around 20 million years ago. Molecular dating of DNA from modern plants suggests the Cannabis genus may have originated further back.
articles.why_it_matters: This discovery may rewrite the early history of the cannabis plant, providing new insights into its origins. The finding has significant implications for our understanding of the plant's evolution and history.

articles.title: Exgerente del PSOE asegura que "nunca" se usaron billetes de 500, 200 o 100 euros para devolver gastos a Ábalos y Koldo
articles.what_happened: El exgerente del PSOE, Mariano Moreno, declaró en el Tribunal Supremo que nunca se utilizaron billetes de 500, 200 o 100 euros para reintegrar gastos a José Luis Ábalos y Koldo García. Esto ocurrió durante su declaración como testigo en el juicio contra Ábalos, Koldo y Víctor de Aldama.
articles.key_details: Moreno indicó que el 99,4% de los gastos se hacían por transferencia y el resto en metálico, y que todas las liquidaciones iban con sus justificantes y recibos de los gastos. También mencionó que las liquidaciones de Ábalos y otros se entregaron al juez Ismael Moreno.
articles.why_it_matters: Esto es importante porque implica que el PSOE sigue un procedimiento de tesorería general y control del gasto, lo que podría influir en el resultado del juicio por presuntas irregularidades en la compra de mascarillas.
